summary: Round 12 storefront FE E2E. Verified: (1) Home 超值套餐 combo dead-state cards & disabled buttons for soldout/ended demos; the active combo 立即抢购 is enabled and routes to checkout (login prompt as expected for logged-out). (2) ?ref=ABCD1234 captured in localStorage as 'ref_code'; navigating to /invite afterwards does not crash. (3) /invite logged-out shows the '登录后查看你的邀请奖励' empty state. rca of the issue: Clerk development instance (sk_test_...) enforces bot-protection on automated submissions. The in-app custom AuthModal calls Clerk's signIn SDK; Clerk server rejects the attempt without returning a visible error that the AuthModal surfaces, so the modal appears to do nothing. Mitigation for testing: use a real browser session OR mint a Clerk session token server-side (per Clerk integration playbook 'Testing' section) and seed it into localStorage/cookies before loading the page. Mitigation for UX: AuthModal should catch the SignIn error and display Clerk's localized message.
